entry.title: Symposium: Mapping the Canon
entry.summary: Presenting new research on canons within canons.
entry.content:
I will be presenting new research at the symposium “Mapping the Canon: Quantitative Approaches to Literary History” at the Technische Universität Darmstadt on June 19, 2026.

The essay is provisionally titled “Canons within Canons?: US literature anthology selections across series.” You can view my slides here.

entry.title: Memorize poems with Anki
entry.summary: A tool to automatically create cloze tests for memorizing poems.
entry.content:
I often challenge my students to memorize poems. And I have long found Anki to be the most effective tool for memorizing information. However, using Anki to memorize poetry is tricky because it is time-consuming to make good flashcards by hand.

So I created a tool to make good poetry memorization flashcards for Anki. You can find the code at this repository.

This will automatically generate cards that treat each word of the poem as a cloze test. Each card shows the test within the context of thirteen lines of the poem (a number chosen so that it would work well on phones, but also because thirteen is a good number).

You can make cards directly from Poetry Foundation URLs, or you can make custom cards. See the README for details.
